candidates.name: Plate Reverse Lunge Twist
candidates.cardText:
Plate Reverse Lunge Twist
Intermediate
1
Step back with your right foot into a lunge position, both knees bent at 90 degrees.
2
Twist your torso to the right, keeping the plate close to your chest.
3
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

candidates.name: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
candidates.cardText:
Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
Beginner
1
Stand straight with the plate held at your side
2
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
3
Return to the upright position.
4
Switch hands and repeat

candidates.name: Plate Russian Twist
candidates.cardText:
Plate Russian Twist
Intermediate
1
Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground
2
Engage your core muscles by pulling your belly button toward your spine.
3
Slowly twist your upper body to the right, keeping your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
4
Hold for a second and then twist to the left, holding for another second.

candidates.name: Plate Standing Twist
candidates.cardText:
Plate Standing Twist
Beginner
1
Stand with a plate extended away from your body. Elbows mostly extended.
2
Rotate at the upper spine while keeping your lumbar spine in a neutral position.
3
Do not let the plate go behind your body.

candidates.name: Plate Wood Chopper
candidates.cardText:
Plate Wood Chopper
Beginner
1
Stand with a shoulder width stance. Begin with the plate near one of your quads.
2
Rotate at your upper spine to engage the obliques.
3
You can pivot your back foot to keep from generating too much torque at the knee.
